plain: John Blitch, a scientist who once worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a news clip from Iraq in 2004, possibly near the town of Tikrit, first aired by the Arabic news network Al Jazeera. He says that when the newscaster Katie Couric played it on air, several times in slow motion, you could clearly see limbs and a blurry, see-through shape climb onto an Abrams, a US Army battle tank, and drop down into the gunner's hatch. He tells it as a glimpse of some kind of invisibility.
